title: iTransformer: Variate-token transformers generalise from 10% of training data on ETTh1, ETTh2
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using iTransformer, a inverted transformer treating variates as tokens. On ETTh1, ETTh2, at horizon 336, Variate-token transformers generalise from 10% of training data on ETTh1, ETTh2. iTransformer maintains within 30% of full-data MSE using 10% of ETTh1 and ETTh2. We discuss two limitations: Evaluation is restricted to public benchmarks and may not reflect production settings. Reported gains use a single held-out split; results across seeds vary by more than the headline MSE difference. Future work should address extending the evaluation to include dlinear and nlinear as baselines. and reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
